name: io.github.turbyho/fw-context-mcp
description: Build-aware code intelligence for embedded C/C++ firmware. Parses compile_commands.json with libclang, extracts every symbol into a persistent SQLite+FTS5 index, and exposes 19 MCP tools: symbol search, source reading, call-graph traversal, hotspot analysis, dead code detection, and vector search. Supports Mbed OS, Zephyr, PlatformIO, and any build system that produces compile_commands.json.
